{{Top|leg}}
'''Light pens''' were instruments used by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Traffic controller/Legends|traffic controllers]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In conjunction with a huge [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] map of the planet, controllers used the light pens draw safe-approach vectors and prioritize landing patterns for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traffic.
